context_requirements: Expression of functional TACR1, TACR2, or TACR3 on the cell surface
An autocrine or paracrine tachykinin (TAC1-derived peptide) signaling loop driving basal transcriptional output
A transcriptional program dependent on tachykinin receptor activity that is measurable in the 978 landmark genes
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent change in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar treatment in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of tachykinin receptor signaling or neuropeptide response signatures among differentially expressed landmark genes
Consistent transcriptional changes across multiple cell lines that are not explained by generic stress or proliferation effects
